title: Count Node Degrees
description: Calculate the degree (number of direct connections) for each node in the graph.

title: Normalize Scores (Optional)
description: Divide each node's degree by (n-1) where n is total number of nodes, to get a value between 0 and 1.

title: Rank Nodes
description: Sort nodes by their centrality scores to identify the most central/influential nodes in the network.
